title: Public API self-billed work order shows itself as Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_steps: 1. Send GET for work order 1 through the Public API.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The response is 200.
  • The Bill To field names customer A, the same customer as the existing customer fields.
